ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description: Connect your personal model provider. Your API key is stored securely and is never shown again.
ai.base_url_help: Enter a service root, API base path, or full chat/completions, responses, or messages URL. Standard paths and endpoint protocols are resolved automatically. Leave blank for provider defaults.
ai.model_search: Search models by name or ID
ai.models_error: Unable to fetch models. Check the connection details and try again.
ai.models_truncated: The provider returned a partial model list. Some models may be missing.
ai.vision_detected: This model supports images. Capabilities are matched against models.dev before using provider metadata.
ai.vision_unavailable: Model metadata indicates that this model accepts text only.
ai.vision_unknown: This custom model is not listed in the capability registry. You can enable image input if your gateway supports it.
ai.image_vision_required: Enable image input in AI settings to attach images.
ai.image_invalid: Use PNG, JPEG or WebP images up to 2 MB each.
ai.image_limit: Use up to 3 images in a conversation.
ai.image_paste_error: Unable to read the pasted image.
ai.key_saved: A key is saved. Leave blank to reuse it only with the same provider and Base URL.
ai.error: Unable to update or load settings. Reload to check the current state.
ai.chat_description: Ask about this workspace or request changes. Changes may take effect immediately. Chat history is temporary and clears when you close or navigate away.
ai.empty_response: The assistant completed without a response.
ai.interrupted_guidance: This response did not finish. You can continue or retry from the composer.
ai.model_tool_fragment: This is text returned by the model. Check the tool records for actual execution results.
ai.tool_no_details: No additional result details were returned.
ai.tool_truncated: This preview is shortened. Open the work item or request a smaller result for more detail.
ai.empty_title: What would you like to work on?
ai.empty_description: Find work items, shape a request, or turn a screenshot into an actionable task.
ai.connect_description: Connect your model once, then work with Plane directly from this sidebar.
ai.suggest_create: Help me turn a request into work items
ai.suggest_image: Create a bug report from a screenshot
ai.composer_hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
ai.service_unavailable: The assistant service is unavailable. Retry shortly, or ask your instance administrator to check the service connection.
ai.configure_required: Connect a model in AI settings to start chatting.
ai.access_denied: You do not have access to this workspace or project.
ai.key_unreadable: Please enter your model API key again in AI settings.
ai.service_busy: Another request is still running. Try again in a moment.
ai.run_limit: This request reached its execution limit. You can continue with a smaller request.
ai.model_error: The model could not finish this response. Check your model connection and try again.
ai.tools_unavailable: Plane tools are unavailable. Ask your instance administrator to check the assistant runtime.
ai.connection_error: The connection was interrupted. You can try again.
ai.check_changes: Some tool operations may have completed. Check their results before repeating a change.
ai.verify_prompt: Check the results of my previous request in Plane before making any further changes.
ai.chat_error: The request did not complete. You can continue this conversation.
